subject: Horizon initiative: proposed coverage and communication playbook
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Horizon initiative: proposed coverage and communication playbook

Team —

Ahead of QBR prep next week I want to share a short proposal for reshaping how we staff and communicate the Horizon initiative in H2. This is a targeted, temporary coverage plan (8–12 weeks) intended to reduce cross-squad context switching and accelerate two priority OKRs: 1) model-variant latency improvements, and 2) end-to-end cost-per-token reduction for streaming use-cases.

What I'm proposing (high level):
- Consolidate three small feature squads into a single 'Horizon Core' pod for focused work on latency and batching (expected 8–12 week horizon).
- Appoint a single lead temporarily (SRO) to manage prioritization, with explicit escalation paths to Product and Eng leads.
- Rationalize on-call and stakeholder coverage so customer-facing comms remain uninterrupted (we keep a rotation).

Why now: recent OKR check-ins show slippage on the latency and cost KR buckets and several downstream teams are blocked waiting on predictable infra changes. The QBR narrative should show a concrete, time-boxed plan that reduces risk and signals decisive resource action.

I've attached a one-pager and a staffing matrix (horizon_realign_v1.pdf, horizon_staff_coverage.xlsx). Please review and flag any immediate blockers. I want to finalize the proposed announcement and change notes by Friday EOD so we can circulate to broader leadership ahead of the town readout.

Request: please reply with either "ack" or specific edits. If you can, annotate the drive doc with line notes by Thursday morning.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon initiative: proposed coverage and communication playbook

Diego —

Ack on the time-box and the single-lead approach. A couple of quick notes after skimming the matrix:
- We should explicitly keep one named PM (customer success liaison) on the rotation so renewals/prospect commitments have a single contact.
- Suggest adding a short FAQ paragraph about impact to DEDICATED vs PRIVATE customers (we need to avoid alarm on capacity/perf differences).

I'll add inline comments in the Drive doc tonight. I also recommend we include a sentence about how this affects hiring prioritization for Q3 (minimal hires; prefer temporary reassignments).

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Experience
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Horizon initiative: proposed coverage and communication playbook

Diego / all —

Quick operational comment: we must list the explicit fallback plan in the announcement (i.e., when we will roll back to previous squad boundaries if targets aren't met). Engineering leadership will want a clear success metric and a mid-point review (week 6) with criteria.

On staffing: the spreadsheet shows a 0.6 allocation of two senior infra engineers — that's tight. If we're serious about shaving latency, we should push to secure a third temporary senior (contractor or internal short-term loan). I've pinged Talent (cc Monica) to ask about contractor options.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
SVP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

Following up on Jonas' ask: Talent can provision short-term contractor support with a 6–12 week window for infra/quant work. Gemma is on this thread and can confirm availability. Two notes:
1) Contractor ramp time will be ~2 weeks for deep infra work — factor that into the mid-point metric.
2) We can prioritize internal loaning of a senior engineer from the Dedicated infra squad; that will cost us temporary capacity on their roadmap.

Gemma — can you share names and rate bands? Also, we should capture any procurement approvals that would be required if rates exceed the reconciled threshold.

Monica

I'll schedule a 30-min touchpoint on Friday to reconcile.
